# Ponto Urbano

> Promotores imobiliários com sede em Aveiro. Apostamos na qualidade, no rigor e em localizações de excelência.
> Property developers based in Aveiro. Committed to quality, rigour and excellent locations.

Ponto Urbano is a real estate developer (promotor imobiliário) based in Aveiro, Portugal. The company designs and builds residential buildings in prime locations across Portugal, with a focus on architectural quality and sustainability.

## Main sections

- [Homepage](https://example.pt/): Introduction to Ponto Urbano and featured projects
- [Services / Projetos](https://example.pt/servicos): Portfolio of current and past residential developments
- [News / Notícias](https://example.pt/noticias): Latest news and updates from Ponto Urbano

## Languages

This website is available in Portuguese (default) and English:
- Portuguese: https://example.pt/
- English: https://example.pt/en/

## Contact

For enquiries, use the contact form available on the website.
